# openprovider_domain_auth_code (Ephemeral Resource)

Reads the auth code of a domain that the account holds. The auth code lets a different account transfer the domain. Terraform does not keep it in the plan or the state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The auth code lets a different registrar transfer the domain. Terraform does
# not keep it in the plan or the state, so give it only to an ephemeral or
# write-only argument.
ephemeral "openprovider_domain_auth_code" "example" {
  domain = "example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) The domain name (e.g., example.com).

### Optional

- `auth_code_type` (String) The type of the auth code: `external` (the default) to transfer the domain to a different registrar, or `internal` to transfer the domain to a different reseller account at OpenProvider.

### Read-Only

- `auth_code` (String, Sensitive) The auth code of the domain.
